<json>
{
  "states": ["Idle", "Publishing", "Subscribing", "Authorizing", "Authorized", "Unauthorized"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive PUBLISH",
      "action": "set topic_name",
      "to": "Publishing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Publishing",
      "event": "cond token_valid",
      "action": "set scope",
      "to": "Authorizing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorizing",
      "event": "cond scope_matches_topic",
      "action": "reply PUBACK",
      "to": "Authorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorizing",
      "event": "cond scope_does_not_match_topic",
      "action": "reply PUBACK 0x87",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive SUBSCRIBE",
      "action": "set topic_filter",
      "to": "Subscribing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Subscribing",
      "event": "cond token_valid",
      "action": "set scope",
      "to": "Authorizing"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorizing",
      "event": "cond filter_subset_of_scope",
      "action": "reply SUBACK",
      "to": "Authorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Authorizing",
      "event": "cond filter_not_subset_of_scope",
      "action": "reply SUBACK 0x87",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Publishing",
      "event": "cond qos_greater_than_0_and_authorization_failed",
      "action": "reply PUBACK 0x87",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Publishing",
      "event": "cond qos_0_and_authorization_failed",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT 0x87",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    },
    {
      "from": "Subscribing",
      "event": "cond authorization_failed",
      "action": "send DISCONNECT 0x87",
      "to": "Unauthorized"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
